name: Monk
art_prompt: a hooded desert monk in a long all-covering brown hooded robe that falls to the ground and hides the feet, the robe a warm earthy brown with darker brown folds, a deep pointed hood whose shadow completely hides the face (only darkness inside the hood: no face, no eyes, no mouth, no skin), both hands tucked together in front of the belly inside the wide joined sleeves, a plain rope belt with hanging knots, a string of wooden prayer beads, a humble, quiet, slightly hunched figure like the robed Monk unit of an old fantasy strategy game
motion: walking slowly with calm steps, the hands kept together in front inside the sleeves
doc: A hooded desert monk who walks in a band of 10 to 30 brothers, keeps its distance like the Spit Cactus, and with the whole band raises its hands for 3 seconds to loose slow, bright blue energy spheres at the hero.

MON-0.note: the top-level strip: since pass 113 a copy of MK-A, the brown robe (Garry: "Let's make the brown ones the default"); before, a placeholder

MK-A.note: Pass 112: the brown-robed Monk (Garry's HoMM3-style monk in our style), a clasped-hands 8-direction walk, a hands-up attack held 3 s, a face-first death

recipe.gait: walking slowly in place on the spot like on a treadmill with calm steps, the hands kept together in front inside the sleeves the whole time, the hood still
recipe.anim_negative: a face, eyes, a mouth, skin inside the hood, swinging arms, hands apart, a weapon, a staff, extra arms, bare feet showing, the hood falling back

view_hints.side: the hood hides the face in profile too, the hands together in front inside the sleeves
view_hints.bd: seen three-quarters from behind: the back of the hood and the robe, the arms going forward to the hands hidden in front of the body
view_hints.fd: seen three-quarters from the front: the dark inside of the hood with no face, the hands together in front inside the sleeves

recipe.back_hint: Seen from behind, both arms bend forward along its sides so the hands are hidden in front of the body: no hands visible from behind.
recipe.windup_hint: starting to raise both arms: the hands coming out of the sleeves and rising to the height of its chest, palms up, the sleeves slipping back, the hood still hiding the face
recipe.aim_hint: with both arms raised high above its hood, the wide sleeves fallen back to the elbows, both hands open with the palms up towards the sky, standing perfectly still, nothing in its hands, the hood still hiding the face
recipe.windup_back_hint: seen from behind, starting to raise both arms to the height of its shoulders, the elbows out to the sides
recipe.aim_back_hint: seen from behind, both arms raised high above the hood, the sleeves fallen back to the elbows, open hands up towards the sky
recipe.dead_hint: fallen forward flat on its face: lying face down on the ground towards the viewer, the hood and the top of its head nearest the viewer at the bottom of the picture, both arms stretched out ahead past the hood, the robe spread out behind it, motionless; seen from the front and a little above; no ground, no sand
